Status: Wave 326 accepted (6.3): the ProjectCompare lambdas from their cached fields

Method.evidence: Thirty-two lambdas in Knx.Ets.ProjectCompare.dll whose metadata names were obfuscated (e.g. <GetDifferences>b__22_0) but whose cached-delegate fields survived as <>9__N_M. The field's delegate type is the lambda's own signature, so the field supplies the ordinal; the owner name comes from 6.4's state machine for that ordinal (e.g. <CompareSpaces>b__22_0, <CompareTopology>b__15_4, <CompareDevices>b__35_2). Generated by perf-now/lambda-waves.py: 132 candidate lambdas were found across the tree, 100 of them already carried the generated name (the obfuscator left <>-prefixed members alone in those classes) and 32 were obfuscated and are applied here.
Method.themes: First wave from the automated lambda chain. The script also reports 4,255 lambdas whose cached field did not survive and 3,066 whose ordinal has no 6.4 state-machine name, so the remaining lambda population needs the caller/IL route rather than the field route.
